quotes.text: and the indifference on AI, which is a very dangerous thing that we are about to do. [...] we are going to prevent States from doing anything to protect the citizens.

I move the committee make in order amendment No. 215, offered by Representative Rivas, which strikes the provision creating a moratorium on States or political subdivisions from enforcing any law or regulation limiting, restricting, or regulating artificial intelligence models, artificial intelligence systems, or automated decision systems entered into interstate commerce.

Ms. Bonamici, I am glad you brought up the AI aspect of this. I am scared out of my mind that there will be a 10-year moratorium on States' ability to be able to kind of regulate AI within their boundaries.
